avoid_supplements.name: Calcium supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Forms insoluble complexes in GI tract, reducing levothyroxine absorption by up to 40%
avoid_supplements.action: Separate dosing by at least 4 hours; take levothyroxine on empty stomach

avoid_supplements.name: Iron supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Forms chelate complexes with levothyroxine, significantly reducing bioavailability
avoid_supplements.action: Separate dosing by at least 4 hours; monitor TSH levels closely

avoid_supplements.name: Magnesium supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Chelation reduces levothyroxine absorption in the GI tract
avoid_supplements.action: Separate administration by at least 4 hours

avoid_supplements.name: Aluminum hydroxide antacids
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Binds levothyroxine, reducing absorption and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; separate dosing by at least 4 hours

avoid_supplements.name: Soy isoflavones
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Inhibits intestinal absorption of levothyroxine; may increase thyroid hormone requirements
avoid_supplements.action: Monitor TSH; may require levothyroxine dose adjustment; separate dosing if possible

avoid_supplements.name: Cottonseed meal
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Contains goitrogens that may reduce levothyroxine effectiveness and increase iodine loss

caution_supplements.name: Iodine supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: Excessive iodine may suppress thyroid hormone secretion or cause thyroiditis in sensitive patients
caution_supplements.action: Monitor TSH and free T4; avoid excessive supplementation (RDA: 150 mcg/day)

caution_supplements.name: Selenium supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: Required for thyroid peroxidase and deiodinase function; excessive doses may interfere with thyroid hormone metabolism
caution_supplements.action: Maintain adequate but not excessive intake (RDA: 55 mcg/day)

caution_supplements.name: Zinc supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: Necessary for thyroid hormone metabolism; high doses may reduce levothyroxine efficacy
caution_supplements.action: Monitor TSH if supplementing above RDA (11 mg/day for men, 8 mg/day for women)

avoid_foods.name: High-fiber foods (when taken with levothyroxine)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Soluble fiber reduces gastric emptying and levothyroxine absorption
avoid_foods.action: Take levothyroxine 30-60 minutes before fiber-containing meals

avoid_foods.name: Soy products (tofu, soy milk, soy protein isolate)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Soy isoflavones inhibit levothyroxine absorption in the small intestine
avoid_foods.action: Maintain consistent intake; may require dose adjustment; separate dosing by 4 hours

avoid_foods.name: Cruciferous vegetables (when consumed in very high amounts)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Goitrogens may inhibit thyroid peroxidase; high intake may increase levothyroxine requirements
avoid_foods.action: Cook vegetables to reduce goitrogen activity; maintain consistent intake; monitor TSH

caution_foods.name: Dairy products and milk
caution_foods.mechanism: Calcium in dairy binds levothyroxine, potentially reducing absorption if taken simultaneously
caution_foods.action: Separate levothyroxine administration from dairy by at least 4 hours

caution_foods.name: Fortified cereals and grain products
caution_foods.mechanism: May contain iron or calcium additives that reduce levothyroxine bioavailability
caution_foods.action: Maintain consistent intake; separate from levothyroxine dosing by 4 hours

caution_foods.name: High-iodine foods (seaweed, kelp, nori)
caution_foods.mechanism: Excessive iodine intake may cause thyroid suppression or interfere with levothyroxine dosing requirements
caution_foods.action: Monitor TSH if iodine intake fluctuates; maintain consistent dietary iodine levels

caution_foods.name: Coffee and caffeinated beverages
caution_foods.mechanism: May slightly reduce levothyroxine absorption if taken simultaneously
caution_foods.action: Take levothyroxine with water only; wait 30 minutes before consuming coffee

monitoring_notes: Levothyroxine has a narrow therapeutic window; monitor TSH and free T4 levels regularly, especially after initiating therapy or adjusting doses. Patient education on proper administration (empty stomach, 30-60 minutes before food/supplements) is critical for maintaining consistent absorption and therapeutic efficacy.
